field_morphology_basis.guidance: Native americanus has generally longer ligule; Gulf berlandieri and introduced Eurasian often overlap in ligule/glume length. Gulf may show smooth/glossy culms like americanus; introduced can have dull/ridged culms. Morphology alone sometimes cannot classify a southern US reed.
field_morphology_basis.photo_requirement: Same-season sheath-retention, exposed mature stem surface, opened true ligule with 1-mm ruler, separately photographed mature lower/upper glumes and documented specimen/voucher
field_morphology_basis.limit: Never diagnose local Texas lineage or approve control based on a source-labelled habitat picture alone
